summary: Gorax highlights the top three Mythic artifacts every player should prioritize when spending Soul Imprints earned from duplicate legendary hero summons. Witch's Remains provides an incredible AoE Defense Penalty II when multi-hit ultimate damage dealers strike enemies. Rift Hourglass grants massive Skill Haste, lowering skill cooldowns to reliably sync support skills with 18-second boss attack rotations. Gatekeeper's Staff converts 100% of overhealing into shields, transforming Defense-scaling healers like Garius into massive team-wide shield generators.

teams.note: Equip multi-hit ultimate damage dealers with Witch's Remains or Misty Conch to apply Defense Penalty II.
Equip Defense-scaling healers with Gatekeeper's Staff to convert overheals into shields and survive big boss hits.

tips: Prioritize purchasing Witch's Remains, Rift Hourglass, and Gatekeeper's Staff with Soul Imprints from duplicate hero pulls.
Ensure heroes equipped with debuff artifacts like Witch's Remains have sufficient Accuracy to meet boss resistance requirements.
Use Rift Hourglass's massive Skill Haste to tune hero skill recasts to match 18-second boss rotation timers in auto-battle skill timing settings.
Save duplicate hero pulls if you plan to craft exclusive artifacts, which require one duplicate copy of that specific hero plus one duplicate copy of any hero.
